ops.reason: Both rules regulate the EPF/IPF requirement that lifters stay at the official competition hotel for the whole event period; the 2026 decision is a version of the same international requirement.
Both regulate the EPF coach accreditation fee of 50 euro at EM/VM; the internationalt rule already holds decisions on 'Trænerakkreditering ved EM og VM'.
The rule regulates the ADEL coach-education requirement for accreditation at international EPF/IPF competitions, which applies to all coaches rather than only to masters.
